business_summary: Agabang&Company operates as a children's clothing and supplies company in South Korea and internationally. The company offers its products under the AGABANG, PETIT Marchons, Dear Baby, EYAEYAO, Agabang Gallery, Putto, Next Mom, and ETTOI brands. Agabang&Company was founded in 1979 and is based in Seoul, South Korea.
business_summary_ko: Agabang&Company는 한국과 해외에서 아동복 및 용품 회사로 운영되고 있습니다. 이 회사는 AGABANG, PETIT Marchons, Dear Baby, EYAEYAO, Agabang Gallery, Putto, Next Mom 및 ETTOI 브랜드로 제품을 제공합니다. Agabang&Company는 1979년에 설립되었으며 대한민국 서울에 본사를 두고 있습니다.
